name: Gantt
purpose: Date-scale task bars composed with timeline. Bars use percentage layout, not a drawing primitive.
scenarios: Scan tasks against a shared date scale
Show an empty state when no tasks exist

locale.description: BCP 47 locale for bundled block copy.

onSelectTask.description: Called when a task bar is activated.

variants.name: density
variants.description: Inherits density from token rungs rather than a local viewport query.

states.name: default
states.description: The schedule has one or more tasks.

antiPatterns: Do not present this CSS percentage layout as a dedicated Gantt drawing engine. Phase 7 records that drawing primitives are insufficient; bars are O(n) inline-size math with no virtualization for large task counts.
Do not claim 21 authored languages; 19 locales are ICU skeletons.

keyboard: Enter or Space selects a task
a11y.focus: Task bars stay in document order with a visible focus ring.
a11y.labeling: Each bar names the task and its start and end dates.

responsive.strategy: Rows use a two-track grid with logical inline-size. Compact viewports keep 44px bar targets via tokens. No viewport media queries.

breakpoints.compact: Chart scrolls inline when the scale overflows.
breakpoints.medium: Label and track sit side by side.
breakpoints.large: Label and track sit side by side.

rtl.strategy: Logical CSS only. Direction comes from locale language. Bars use inset-inline-start.
